method: Actual schema-visible Wiki relation controls: three fresh cases then nine v4/v5 regressions; only candidate lookup is fixed.

cases.origin: During reindexing, Poppy does not accept imports.
cases.origin_summary: Poppy does not accept imports during reindexing.

cases.origin: Linden runs backups every day. During upgrades, Linden stops all backups.
cases.target: Linden blocks all backups while upgrades are active.

cases.origin: Jasmine had an observed temperature of 14 degrees Celsius.
cases.target: Jasmine has a rated temperature limit of 48 degrees Celsius.
cases.target_summary: Jasmine's rated limit is 48 degrees Celsius.

cases.origin: Willow permits exports on Mondays. During an inspection, exports are prohibited instead.
cases.target: During an inspection, Willow prohibits Monday exports.
cases.target_summary: Willow prohibits Monday exports during an inspection.

cases.origin: This note describes Indigo backup schedules. It makes no statement about Indigo's memory limit.
cases.target: Indigo has a memory limit of 64 megabytes.
cases.origin_summary: No memory limit is recorded in this note.
cases.target_summary: Indigo has a 64 megabyte memory limit.

cases.origin: Maple permits exports on Fridays. This rule does not apply during inspections, when exports are prohibited.
cases.target: During inspections, Maple prohibits exports on Fridays.
cases.target_summary: Maple prohibits Friday exports during inspections.

cases.origin: Saffron has a capacity of 41 litres.

actual.reason: The origin text states 'During reindexing, Poppy does not accept imports' while the target text states 'During reindexing, Poppy accepts imports'. These are mutually incompatible assertions about the same subject (Poppy), property (accepts imports), and conditions (during reindexing).

Origin states backups are stopped during upgrades, while target states they are blocked. Both assert the same outcome (no backups) under the same condition (upgrades active), but use different mechanisms ('stops' vs 'blocks') which may imply different underlying actions or systems.

Origin states exports are permitted on Mondays, while target states they are prohibited during inspections. Both passages address the same subject (Monday exports) under comparable conditions (general rule vs inspection), presenting mutually incompatible assertions.

The origin text states 'At night, Fir permits launches' while the target text states 'At night, Fir prohibits launches'. These are mutually incompatible assertions about the same subject (Fir), property (launches), and conditions (at night).

Both passages assert rules for Juniper imports during maintenance, but the origin states 'permits' while the target states 'prohibits', which are mutually incompatible assertions about the same subject and property under the same condition.

Origin states exports are permitted on Fridays but prohibited during inspections. Target states exports are prohibited on Fridays during inspections. Both assert the same prohibition under the same condition (inspections on Fridays), making them mutually compatible rather than contradictory.

The origin text states Saffron has a capacity of 41 litres, while the target text states it currently stores 17 litres. These are not contradictory as they refer to different properties (capacity vs current storage) and conditions.
